text:
maia: Quick sync — pulled notes from today's onboarding calls (Brightline, Nebula, AcuityPay). Consolidated asks below, putting renewal-risk ones first. Can product + eng flag quick wins and owners before EOD?

maia: Brightline — urgent: per-route cost toggle and a per-route usage export for finance. Quote: "we can't renew without line-item cost views". Renewal in 6 weeks. :rotating_light:

vikram: Ack. Who owns per-route billing in the roadmap? Seems close to billing team's domain. cc @juan for prioritization.

juan: I can triage. Quick notes from call: 
- per-route toggle: expected UX + API (backend csv export)
- per-route attribution: need to map token-level usage to routes (they want last 90 days)
- small ask: default route labels for integrations

zoe: Pasted customer quote from call recording: "When our finance team runs the renewal model they need per-route TTLs and cost per token. Right now it's a black box."

maia: Nebula — embedding freshness/staleness pain. Request: endpoint to bulk re-embed and a cronable job for TTL-based invalidation. They're hitting incorrect search results. Renewal not immediate but frustrated.

ryan-eng: For bulk re-embed we have a prototype script (internal). We can expose a simple API + job runner. Rough ETA: 2 sprints for an MVP if we scope to CSV job + status endpoint.

vikram: Sounds good. Can we split into (A) internal re-embed job + (B) a UI to trigger for CS? Prioritize A as quick win.

juan: Agreed. I'll open a ticket: PROD-embed-batch with acceptance criteria and link to call notes.

maia: AcuityPay asks (lower risk): onboarding checklist export (spreadsheet) and clearer in-console steps for webhook setup.

zoe: I added a short checklist snippet from the call:
```
1) Create project
2) Add API key with route tags
3) Verify webhook ping (status 200)
4) Run sample inference with test dataset
```

maia: Overall ask: please tag the ask with impact and effort. My suggested quick triage: 
- Brightline per-route export/toggle = P0 (renewal risk) / Effort: M
- Nebula bulk re-embed job = P1 / Effort: S-M
- AcuityPay checklist UI/export = P2 / Effort: S

ryan-eng: I'll scope the re-embed API in a PR draft and link expected infra costs. Quick question: for Nebula TTL, is default 7 days or 30?

maia: Nebula prefers 7 day TTL but wants configurable. Add as optional param.

juan: Created PROD-5221 (customer-feedback: per-route billing export) and PROD-5222 (embed-batch-job). Links: https://internal.redwood/prod/5221 , https://internal.redwood/prod/5222

cs-bot: New doc created: "onboard-feedback-1759994321" — https://docs.redwood/inbox/onboard-feedback-1759994321 (automated capture) :robot_face:

vikram: Great. Action items: 1) Juan to own per-route ticket + sync with billing 2) Ryan to draft re-embed PR + cost note 3) Maia/CS to prepare customer-facing one-pager for Brightline renewal (due in 4 days).

maia: Thanks team. If anyone can volunteer to make the one-pager template (even a quick Google Slides) ping me. Prefer someone with renewals experience. :pray:

zoe: I'll draft the first cut by EOD and drop in the doc.

ryan-eng: Will start the PR draft today, ETA end of next week for MVP branch.

juan: I'll loop in billing and post a short plan in the ticket.

maia: Perfect — I'll follow up in product sync tomorrow with the triage statuses. :white_check_mark:
